sentences.translation: 我会全力关注此事。

sentences.sentence: Most of these should be easy to understand if you think in terms of the JVM as a stack-based processor, so I won't go into details here.
sentences.translation: 如果将 JVM 想象为基于堆栈的处理器，则其中大多数是容易理解的，因此我在这里就不再详细说明了。

sentences.sentence: In this article I will not go into details on any of the above mentioned tasks, but will concentrate on the game loop alone.
sentences.translation: 在本文我不会深入前面提到的各种任务的详细实现，而是专注于游戏循环这一点。

sentences.sentence: shop windows displaying the latest fashions
sentences.translation: 展示最新时装的商店橱窗

sentences.sentence: All the exam results will be displayed on the noticeboard.
sentences.translation: 所有的考试成绩将在布告板上公布。

sentences.sentence: The cruelest insult, on the contrary, which can be offered to the unfortunate, is to appear to make light of their calamities.
sentences.translation: 反过来说，对不幸者最大的侮辱似乎是不幸的境遇遭到轻视。

sentences.sentence: But on the few occasions when this had happened he could never think of anything to say and he suffered agonies of embarrassment at his dumbness.
sentences.translation: 但在少数场合，当这种情况发生时，他却根本想不起说什么话来，对于自己的垭口无言感到极大的苦恼和困惑。

sentences.sentence: That is why dumbness is most often the highest expression of happiness of unhappiness.
sentences.translation: 因此沉默往往是幸福或不幸的最高表现形式。

sentences.sentence: Sometimes, Angela might still feel sad, missing her parents, feeling lonely, hating her dumbness or something.
sentences.translation: 有时，安琪拉可能仍然失踪感到悲伤的时候，她的父母，觉得孤独，那恨他的沉默或什么的。

translations.translation: 转移某人的注意力，忘掉

sentences.sentence: There was no tactful way of phrasing what he wanted to say.
sentences.translation: 没有办法婉转地表达他想说的话。

sentences.sentence: a tactful man
sentences.translation: 一个圆通的人

sentences.sentence: Jack is tough, but always straightforward and fair.
sentences.translation: 虽然杰克很严厉，但一向坦诚公正。

sentences.sentence: I found him very arrogant and opinionated.
sentences.translation: 我觉得他非常傲慢和固执。

sentences.sentence: Employers have an obligation to treat all employees equally.
sentences.translation: 雇主有责任对所有员工一视同仁。

sentences.sentence: Parents are under a legal obligation to educate their children.
sentences.translation: 家长对子女的教育负有法律责任。

sentences.sentence: You are under no obligation to buy any more books.
sentences.translation: 你不必非要买更多的书。

sentences.sentence: Greater resources are needed to meet these obligations.
sentences.translation: 履行这些义务需要更多的资源。

sentences.sentence: the rights and obligations imposed on them by treaties
sentences.translation: 条约给他们规定的权利和义务

sentences.sentence: The government must pay for health care for war veterans – it is an obligation we owe to them.
sentences.translation: 政府必须为退伍军人支付医疗保健费用——这是我们对他们负有的义务。

sentences.sentence: a moral obligation to help the poor
sentences.translation: 帮助穷人的道德义务

sentences.sentence: He stayed with the team out of a sense of obligation.
sentences.translation: 他出于责任感而留在队里。

phrases.translation: 不得已；必然地，不可避免地

sentences.sentence: She saw books as a necessity, not a luxury.
sentences.translation: 她视书籍为必需品而非奢侈品。

sentences.sentence: A car is an absolute necessity if you live in the country.
sentences.translation: 你要是住在乡下，绝对需要有辆汽车。

sentences.sentence: There is no suggestion that clients have been sold inappropriate policies.
sentences.translation: 没有迹象表明向客户出售过不适当的保险单。

sentences.sentence: Communications that show up in your voice mail, or by email, courier, express mail, or snail mail should be welcome, too.
sentences.translation: 通过语音邮件，电子邮件，信差，快递或普通邮件传递给你的信息都是受欢迎的（好的消息吧）。

sentences.sentence: The same goes for filing, checking voice mail, updating our calendars, checking our calendars, checking stats on stocks or web traffic, all of these tasks can and should be batched.
sentences.translation: 与此类似的还有文件归档，查看语音邮件，更新日程表，检查日程表，留意股市信息或是网络交易信息，所有这些工作可以而且应该打包处理。

sentences.sentence: One is that customer service was an early and inevitable casualty when retailers responded to brutal competition by replacing employees with technology such as 1～800 numbers and voice mail.
sentences.translation: 一方面当零售商应对残酷的竞争用1到800的数目和语音邮件等技术取代员工后，客户服务就成了早期的也是不可避免的受害者。

sentences.sentence: The funeral will be held at St. Martin’s Church.
sentences.translation: 葬礼将在圣马丁教堂举行。

sentences.sentence: Hundreds of mourners attended the funeral of the two boys.
sentences.translation: 数百名哀悼者参加了那两个男孩的葬礼。

sentences.sentence: the minister who conducted the funeral service
sentences.translation: 主持葬礼的牧师

sentences.sentence: Nelson’s funeral procession down the Thames
sentences.translation: 沿泰晤士河而下为纳尔逊送葬的队伍

sentences.sentence: Ramdas set fire to the funeral pyre .
sentences.translation: 拉姆达斯点燃了火葬柴堆。

sentences.translation: 她一向准时赴约。

text:
英语词汇 · 北师高中 · 第 130 单元

liar
音标：英 /'laɪə/  美 /'laɪɚ/
n. 说谎者
例句：Are you calling me a liar?
你是说我在撒谎？

dialect
音标：英 /'daɪəlekt/  美 /'daɪə'lɛkt/
n. 方言，土语
短语：chinese dialect — 中国方言
短语：local dialect — 地区方言
例句：the local dialect
当地方言

spinach
音标：英 /'spɪnɪdʒ; -ɪtʃ/  美 /'spɪnɪtʃ/
n. 菠菜
短语：water spinach — n. 空心菜；雍菜；瓮菜
短语：spinach salad — 菠菜沙拉
例句：The spinach is shrivelled up.
菠菜蔫了。
例句：Some of the best brain foods: walnuts, blueberries and spinach.
一些最好的“大脑食物”：胡桃、蓝莓和菠菜。

excessive
音标：英 /ɪkˈsesɪv/  美 /ɪkˈsɛsɪv/
adj. 过分的
短语：excessive competition — 过度竞争
短语：excessive drinking — 酗酒；过度饮酒
短语：excessive consumption — 过度消耗；超前消费
短语：excessive pressure — 剩余压力；过度压力
短语：excessive noise — 过度噪音；过分的吵闹声
短语：excessive demand — 过剩需求；过量需求；需求过旺
短语：excessive wear — 过度磨损
短语：excessive speed — 超速
短语：excessive production capacity — 过剩生产能力
例句：his excessive drinking
他的酗酒
例句：$15 for two beers seems a little excessive.
两杯啤酒要15美元，似乎有点过分。

undivided
音标：英 /ʌndɪ'vaɪdɪd/  美 /,ʌndɪ'vaɪdɪd/
adj. 完整的；未分开的
短语：undivided attention — 一心一意
例句：I’ll give the matter my undivided attention.
我会全力关注此事。

go into details
详述，逐一细说
例句：Most of these should be easy to understand if you think in terms of the JVM as a stack-based processor, so I won't go into details here.
如果将 JVM 想象为基于堆栈的处理器，则其中大多数是容易理解的，因此我在这里就不再详细说明了。
例句：In this article I will not go into details on any of the above mentioned tasks, but will concentrate on the game loop alone.
在本文我不会深入前面提到的各种任务的详细实现，而是专注于游戏循环这一点。

display
音标：英 /dɪ'spleɪ/  美 /dɪ'sple/
vt. 陈列，展览，显示
短语：on display — 展览，公开展出
短语：digital display — [计]数字显示
短语：lcd display — n. 液晶显示器；液晶屏幕
短语：liquid crystal display — 液晶显示；液晶显示器
短语：liquid crystal display (LCD) — 液晶体显示
短语：liquid crystal display (lcd) — 液晶体显示
短语：display system — [计]显示系统
短语：led display — abbr. 发光二极管显示器（light-emitting diode display）
短语：display screen — 显示屏幕
短语：display device — [计]显示设备
短语：display panel — 显示面板，表示盘
短语：display module — 显示组件，显示模组
短语：panel display — 平板显示；显示板
短语：image display — 图像显示
短语：color display — 彩色显示器；彩色展示
短语：visual display — 直观显示；视觉显示；光学显示；可见显示
短语：data display — 资料显示，数据显示
短语：plasma display — 等离子体显示（器）
短语：flat panel display — 平面直角显示器
短语：video display — n. 视频显示；视频显示器
例句：shop windows displaying the latest fashions
展示最新时装的商店橱窗
例句：All the exam results will be displayed on the noticeboard.
所有的考试成绩将在布告板上公布。

put sb. down
羞辱

make light of
轻视，忽略
例句：The cruelest insult, on the contrary, which can be offered to the unfortunate, is to appear to make light of their calamities.
反过来说，对不幸者最大的侮辱似乎是不幸的境遇遭到轻视。

dumbness
n. 无言，沉默
例句：But on the few occasions when this had happened he could never think of anything to say and he suffered agonies of embarrassment at his dumbness.
但在少数场合，当这种情况发生时，他却根本想不起说什么话来，对于自己的垭口无言感到极大的苦恼和困惑。
例句：That is why dumbness is most often the highest expression of happiness of unhappiness.
因此沉默往往是幸福或不幸的最高表现形式。
例句：Sometimes, Angela might still feel sad, missing her parents, feeling lonely, hating her dumbness or something.
有时，安琪拉可能仍然失踪感到悲伤的时候，她的父母，觉得孤独，那恨他的沉默或什么的。

get one's mind off
转移某人的注意力，忘掉

tactful
音标：英 /'tæktfʊl; -f(ə)l/  美 /'tæktfl/
adj. 圆通的；得体的
例句：There was no tactful way of phrasing what he wanted to say.
没有办法婉转地表达他想说的话。
例句：a tactful man
一个圆通的人

straightforward
音标：英 /streɪt'fɔːwəd/  美 /,stret'fɔrwɚd/
adj. 坦率的，直截了当的
例句：Jack is tough, but always straightforward and fair.
虽然杰克很严厉，但一向坦诚公正。

opinionated
音标：英 /ə'pɪnjəneɪtɪd/  美 /ə'pɪnjənetɪd/
adj. 固执己见的
例句：I found him very arrogant and opinionated.
我觉得他非常傲慢和固执。

obligation
音标：英 /ɒblɪ'geɪʃ(ə)n/  美 /,ɑblɪ'ɡeʃən/
n. 义务，职责，责任
短语：no obligation — 无义务
短语：moral obligation — 道义上的责任
短语：legal obligation — n. 法律义务
短语：contractual obligation — 合同义务；契约责任
短语：without obligation — 不计价
短语：financial obligation — 债务；财政承担
例句：Employers have an obligation to treat all employees equally.
雇主有责任对所有员工一视同仁。
例句：Parents are under a legal obligation to educate their children.
家长对子女的教育负有法律责任。
例句：You are under no obligation to buy any more books.
你不必非要买更多的书。
例句：Greater resources are needed to meet these obligations.
履行这些义务需要更多的资源。
例句：the rights and obligations imposed on them by treaties
条约给他们规定的权利和义务
例句：The government must pay for health care for war veterans – it is an obligation we owe to them.
政府必须为退伍军人支付医疗保健费用——这是我们对他们负有的义务。
例句：a moral obligation to help the poor
帮助穷人的道德义务
例句：He stayed with the team out of a sense of obligation.
他出于责任感而留在队里。

necessity
音标：英 /nɪ'sesɪtɪ/  美 /nə'sɛsəti/
n. 需要，必需，必要
短语：of necessity — 必然地；不可避免地
短语：out of necessity — 出于需要，必定
短语：by necessity — 不得已；必然地，不可避免地
短语：logical necessity — 必然性，逻辑的必然性
例句：She saw books as a necessity, not a luxury.
她视书籍为必需品而非奢侈品。
例句：A car is an absolute necessity if you live in the country.
你要是住在乡下，绝对需要有辆汽车。

inappropriate
音标：英 /ɪnə'prəʊprɪət/  美 /'ɪnə'proprɪət/
adj. 不合宜的，不适当的
短语：be inappropriate for — 不适当的；不合适的
例句：There is no suggestion that clients have been sold inappropriate policies.
没有迹象表明向客户出售过不适当的保险单。

voice mail
语音信箱
例句：Communications that show up in your voice mail, or by email, courier, express mail, or snail mail should be welcome, too.
通过语音邮件，电子邮件，信差，快递或普通邮件传递给你的信息都是受欢迎的（好的消息吧）。
例句：The same goes for filing, checking voice mail, updating our calendars, checking our calendars, checking stats on stocks or web traffic, all of these tasks can and should be batched.
与此类似的还有文件归档，查看语音邮件，更新日程表，检查日程表，留意股市信息或是网络交易信息，所有这些工作可以而且应该打包处理。
例句：One is that customer service was an early and inevitable casualty when retailers responded to brutal competition by replacing employees with technology such as 1～800 numbers and voice mail.
一方面当零售商应对残酷的竞争用1到800的数目和语音邮件等技术取代员工后，客户服务就成了早期的也是不可避免的受害者。

funeral
音标：英 /'fjuːn(ə)r(ə)l/  美 /'fjunərəl/
n. 葬礼，出殡
短语：funeral home — n. （美）殡仪馆
短语：funeral service — 丧礼仪式
短语：funeral procession — 送葬
短语：state funeral — n. 国葬
短语：funeral and interment — 殡葬
短语：funeral expenses — 殡殓费，丧葬费
短语：wedding and funeral — 红白喜事
短语：funeral parlor — n. 殡仪馆
短语：funeral parlour — n. 殡仪馆
短语：funeral march — 葬礼进行曲，送葬曲
例句：The funeral will be held at St. Martin’s Church.
葬礼将在圣马丁教堂举行。
例句：Hundreds of mourners attended the funeral of the two boys.
数百名哀悼者参加了那两个男孩的葬礼。
例句：the minister who conducted the funeral service
主持葬礼的牧师
例句：Nelson’s funeral procession down the Thames
沿泰晤士河而下为纳尔逊送葬的队伍
例句：Ramdas set fire to the funeral pyre .
拉姆达斯点燃了火葬柴堆。

punctual
音标：英 /'pʌŋ(k)tʃʊəl; -tjʊəl/  美 /'pʌŋtʃʊəl/
adj. 严守时刻的，准时的
例句：She’s always very punctual for appointments.
她一向准时赴约。
例句：the punctual payment of invoices
准时结清费用清单
